# Native Review Brief — Multiplayer UX Sprint A+B Strings

**Generated**: 2026-05-04
**Companion to**: `multiplayer-ux-2026-05-04.md`
**Status**: ⚠️ ALL non-English strings below are AI-generated by Claude. **Native speaker review required before public release.**

This document lists every translation string added during the multiplayer UX audit shipping cycle. For each string: the English source text, the target translation, the UX context, and any constraints a translator should respect. Reviewers should:

1. Verify the meaning matches the English source.
2. Check tone/register fits the project's playful "neo-brutalist Jackbox party-pack" voice (see `.impeccable.md`).
3. Flag any false-friend or grammatically awkward output.
4. Replace anything that needs change directly in `fe-next/translations/{he,sv,ja,es}.js`.

---

## 1. Game-mode picker — "Random" chip

**Key**: `multiplayerFlow.createModal.modeRandom`
**Context**: Label on the "Random" chip in the create-room modal's game-mode picker (5-chip radiogroup). Sits next to Classic / Blast / Word Hunt / Wheel Rush. Shown when host is choosing what mode to host.
**Constraint**: Must be brief (chip width ~70px), one word ideally. Same register as existing mode labels.
**English source**: `Random`

| Locale | Translation | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| 🇮🇱 he | `מקרי` | Adjective form, masculine singular. Alternative: `אקראי` (more technical). |
| 🇸🇪 sv | `Slumpmässigt` | Adverb form. Alternative: `Slump` (noun, shorter, more playful). |
| 🇯🇵 ja | `ランダム` | Katakana loanword — standard for game UI. |
| 🇪🇸 es | `Aleatorio` | Standard. Alternative: `Al azar` (more casual). |

## 2. Host-left grace modal — title

**Key**: `multiplayerFlow.hostLeftModal.title`
**Context**: Modal title shown to a player when the host has left the room. Replaces a 4-second toast with a 10-second grace modal.
**Constraint**: Short (3-5 words). Plays in `font-neo-display` uppercase.
**English source**: `Host Left`

| Locale | Translation | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| 🇮🇱 he | `המארח עזב` | Past tense, masculine. Consider: `המארח/ת עזב/ה` for inclusive. |
| 🇸🇪 sv | `Värden lämnade` | Past tense. Alternative: `Värden gick` (more colloquial). |
| 🇯🇵 ja | `ホストが退出しました` | Polite past form. May feel formal — alt: `ホストが退出` (more punchy). |
| 🇪🇸 es | `El anfitrión se fue` | Past tense, masculine. Alt for inclusive: `Se fue el anfitrión/a`. |

---

## 3. Host-left grace modal — body

**Key**: `multiplayerFlow.hostLeftModal.body`
**Context**: Body copy explaining the room is closing and the user can wait or leave now. Em-dash divides the explanation from the call-to-action hint.
**Constraint**: 1-2 sentences. Em-dash (—) renders correctly in RTL via `dir={dir}` on the dialog.
**English source**: `The room is closing. Returning to the lobby in a few seconds — or tap below to leave now.`

| Locale | Translation | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| 🇮🇱 he | `החדר נסגר. חוזרים ללובי תוך כמה שניות — או הקש כאן כדי לצאת עכשיו.` | "כאן" → ambiguous. Consider: `הקש למטה`. |
| 🇸🇪 sv | `Rummet stängs. Du återgår till lobbyn om några sekunder — eller tryck nedan för att lämna nu.` | Direct, fine. |
| 🇯🇵 ja | `ルームを閉じています。数秒後にロビーへ戻ります — すぐ戻るには下をタップ。` | Em-dash in JA is unusual; consider replacing with `。` or 「ー」 stylistically. |
| 🇪🇸 es | `La sala se está cerrando. Volviendo al lobby en unos segundos — o toca abajo para salir ahora.` | Direct, fine. |

## 4. Host-left grace modal — exit-now button

**Key**: `multiplayerFlow.hostLeftModal.exitNow`
**Context**: Primary CTA on the grace modal. Lime-colored button, uppercase tracking. User clicks to exit immediately instead of waiting for the 10s countdown.
**Constraint**: Short, action-oriented verb phrase. Must fit one line on a 380px-wide modal.
**English source**: `Back to lobby now`

| Locale | Translation | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| 🇮🇱 he | `חזרה ללובי עכשיו` | Standard. Alt: `ללובי עכשיו` (more punchy). |
| 🇸🇪 sv | `Tillbaka till lobbyn nu` | Direct. Alt: `Tillbaka nu` (shorter). |
| 🇯🇵 ja | `すぐにロビーへ戻る` | Polite-neutral. Standard. |
| 🇪🇸 es | `Volver al lobby ahora` | Direct. Alt: `Al lobby ya` (more casual). |

## 5. Session-migrated toast

**Key**: `multiplayerFlow.sessionMigrated`
**Context**: Toast (5s) shown when the user opens the game in a second tab and the original tab is "demoted". Currently the user saw this in English even when their UI was in HE/SV/JA/ES.
**Constraint**: Brief (toast width). Should sound like an explanation, not an error.
**English source**: `Switched to your other tab.`

| Locale | Translation | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| 🇮🇱 he | `עברנו ללשונית השנייה שלך.` | Sounds slightly awkward. Alt: `המשחק עבר ללשונית השנייה.` |
| 🇸🇪 sv | `Bytte till din andra flik.` | Direct. |
| 🇯🇵 ja | `別のタブに切り替えました。` | Polite past. Standard. |
| 🇪🇸 es | `Cambiado a tu otra pestaña.` | Direct. Alt: `Movido a tu otra pestaña.` |

## 6. Host-transferred-to-other toast

**Key**: `hostView.hostTransferredToOther`
**Context**: 3-second neutral toast shown to a player who **just lost** host status (e.g., admin-forced transfer or auto-transfer to next-most-active player). Crown icon. Replaces previous silent demote.
**Constraint**: Brief, neutral tone — not an error or alarm. Must convey "host changed" without sounding like the user did anything wrong.
**English source**: `A new host has taken over.`

| Locale | Translation | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| 🇮🇱 he | `מארח חדש קיבל את ההגה.` | "Got the wheel" idiom — colloquial. Alt literal: `מארח חדש השתלט.` |
| 🇸🇪 sv | `En ny värd har tagit över.` | Direct, fine. |
| 🇯🇵 ja | `新しいホストに交代しました。` | Polite past, neutral. Alt: `ホストが交代しました` (shorter). |
| 🇪🇸 es | `Un nuevo anfitrión tomó el control.` | Direct. Alt: `Hay un nuevo anfitrión.` (softer). |

## Quick action checklist for reviewer

For each string above:

- [ ] Hebrew (he) — review by Hebrew-fluent speaker
- [ ] Swedish (sv) — review by Swedish-fluent speaker
- [ ] Japanese (ja) — review by Japanese-fluent speaker
- [ ] Spanish (es) — review by Spanish-fluent speaker

Edit `fe-next/translations/{he,sv,ja,es}.js` directly when changing. The English source in `fe-next/translations/en.js` is the canonical reference and should match the intent.

After review, delete this file (or move to `docs/audits/archive/`) and clear the "AI-generated, needs native review" caveat from any session memory.
